text:
Maya: Quick sync — planning to rollout model v2.3.1-quant to prod tonight 23:00 PT (30m quiet window). Canary plan: 5% (10m) -> 25% (10m) -> full (if green). Posting rollback criteria + owners below, please ack or call out gaps.

Alex: I can lead the deploy. On call: Jon (SRE), Priya (runtime). I'll own the canary steps and ramp.

Maya: Runbook is here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-model-v2.3.1 — smoke checklist under "Canary smoke". Quick paste of the smoke steps so folks don't have to open doc: 
```
# smoke against canary
export CANARY_URL=https://canary.inference.us-west-2.redwood
./scripts/smoke_inference.sh --endpoint $CANARY_URL --payload testdata/small.json
./scripts/check_perf.sh --endpoint $CANARY_URL --metric p95
```

Jon: Alerts I'm watching (I'll enable now): infra/latency-p95 > +250ms (baseline) for 5m, infra/error-rate > 0.5% for 2m, model/omission-rate > 0.2% for 10m. If any fire, I'll post rollback recommendation and set traffic back to v2.2.0.

Priya: Rollback command ready and tested in staging. Two-step rollback listed here: 
```
# rollback to v2.2.0
gcloud run deploy inference --image gcr.io/redwood/model:v2.2.0 --region us-west2 --platform managed
curl -s -X POST "$OPS_ENDPOINT/flush_cache?env=prod" || true
```
I'll also disable batching config (if needed) with: `curl -X POST $OPS_ENDPOINT/config/toggle?batching=off`

Alex: Rollback criteria (ops agreed):
- sustained p95 increase > 250ms vs baseline for 5 consecutive minutes
- error rate spike > 0.5% for 2 consecutive minutes
- regression on our sample prompts (smoke script returns fewer than 95% pass)
If any of these happen during canary ramp, we stop the ramp and roll back.

Maya: Owners please react with :thumbsup: to ack and add any extra checks. Also tagging @deploy-bot to confirm the scheduled window.

Alex: :thumbsup: I'll run the canary commands and post status at each step (5% started, 25% started, full).

Jon: :thumbsup: I'll post any alert hits + quick logs (trace IDs) if something looks wrong.

Priya: :thumbsup: I will be standing by to execute rollback steps and coordinate KV flush.

deploy-bot: Deployment window scheduled: dep-20240405-2300 (ID: dep-1712345678). Reminder 15m before window.

Maya: Small operational note — we'll keep a 2-person quiet-window: Alex + Jon. If either of you needs to escalate, ping @oncall-eng and I'll jump in.

Alex: One more preflight: confirming DB config toggle is off for this deploy (feature flag: inference.batch_shaping=false). Priya, can you validate?

Priya: Confirmed flag off in prod config. Added a quick check: `curl $CONFIG_SERVICE/flags | jq '.inference.batch_shaping'` returns false.

Maya: Perfect. Final check — are we comfortable with the rollback latency (actionable within 3 minutes)?

Jon: Yes — rollback command is automated in our ops runbook, takes ~90s for image swap + ~60s for cache flush. I'll keep the traffic steering ready to revert immediately.

Maya: All right, we have owners + criteria + rollback commands. If no objections, this thread is the source of truth for tonight's window. I'll start the window at 23:00 PT and post status updates.

Alex: No objections from me. Go for deploy when ready.

Priya: Acknowledged.

Jon: Acknowledged.

Maya: Going to mark this as "ready". Please be on Slack 10m before start. I'll post canary start updates in this thread.

Alex: 👍
